outcome: Bayley Scales of Infant and Toddler Development, 3rd edition (BSID-III) scores
cohort: The study evaluated 66 mother-infant pairs from the DSAN-12m birth cohort in the Reconcavo Baiano, Brazil.
finding: Higher infant FT4 levels were significantly associated with enhanced motor skills, particularly among boys, while maternal TT3 levels were positively associated with language development and TSH concentrations were negatively associated with language development.
